title: Extended noise mass on the diagonal
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with $2\leq |\Omega|$, let $\rho\in\mathbb{R}$, and take $x\in\Omega$. The extended noise mass at $(x,x)$ equals $\rho+(1-\rho)/|\Omega|$.
